_note: Raw per-run output behind the multi-node full-topology baseline in docs/efficiency.md. Produced by benchmarks/nexmark_compare/cloud/full-run.sh; not hand-edited. One row per run: one engine, one query, one trial, parallelism 12 across three worker nodes, CPU and memory summed over every engine node (control + 3 workers).
_premise: NEW BASELINE, not comparable row-for-row to the split-rig rounds: 5 nodes (control ccx13 + 3x ccx23 workers + ccx23 broker), parallelism 12, every keyed shuffle crossing real hosts. taskmanager.memory.process.size EXPLICITLY 6g (image default is 1728m, which every earlier round ran) - required, because at 1728m Flink's q18/q19 source stalls deterministically (~1.08M of 9.2M) and never drains; at 6g it drains. Flink's memory column therefore reflects the raised setting and must not be compared to earlier rounds. clink workers ran --slots=48 (a scheduling cap; 16 made q5's 120-task plan unschedulable).
_dataset: CANONICAL: 9,200,000 nexmark bid records over 12 partitions, generated on the rig by clink's deterministic generator (full-load-canonical.sh, seed 1).

_caveats.q11_qhop_clink_spread: clink efficiency spread 1.28x/1.29x over three trials; indicative.
_caveats.trials: three per (query, engine); consumer group unique per trial (a shared group resumes at the committed offset and reads nothing - found and fixed in this run).
_caveats.sink: blackhole both engines; correctness gated separately (16/16 append-only + 4/4 changelog, 2026-07-28/29).

rig: 5x Hetzner nbg1: ccx13 control + 3x ccx23 workers + ccx23 broker, host networking, private net
